cur-fossil-shanidar.dateNote: In 1957 Ralph Solecki's team found the skeleton of an adult Neanderthal, Shanidar 1, in this cave in the Zagros Mountains of Iraqi Kurdistan. Digs from 1951 to 1960 found ten Neanderthals, about 0.07–0.045 million years old.
cur-fossil-shanidar.summary: A cave in Iraqi Kurdistan where ten Neanderthals were found.

cur-fossil-azykh.dateNote: In June 1968 Mammadali Huseynov's team found part of an archaic human jaw in this cave in the Lesser Caucasus, Azerbaijan. Uncertain age: estimates run from about 0.45 to 0.05 million years.
cur-fossil-azykh.summary: A cave in Azerbaijan with one of the oldest human jaws in the Caucasus.
